changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.02[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Premiere Lists[/COLOR]
-New Sync your devices, at the end of Premiere Lists: the same Premiere Lists on every device at home where you use luc_kodi, for example a tablet and an NVIDIA SHIELD. No account and no outside server: the devices talk to each other over your home network.
-Each device is paired once with an 8-digit PIN. On one device choose Show a PIN on this device; on the other, Join a device. luc_kodi finds the other devices on your network by itself, so you only pick the device by its name and type the PIN. If your network hides them, Enter address manually... asks for the device's IP address.
-The PIN is only used to pair and is valid for 5 minutes. After 5 wrong PINs pairing closes and a new PIN has to be shown. Paired devices then share a private key, and every sync is signed with it.
-Once paired, lists sync on their own: when Kodi starts, a few seconds after you change a list, every 10 minutes, and when you open Premiere Lists. A device that is off catches up the next time both are on.
-New, renamed and deleted lists, and titles added to or removed from a list, reach the other devices. A list with the same name created on two devices becomes a single list.
-Each device keeps its own countdowns, notifications and library: a premiere that has aired is added to the library of every device that has it in a list.
-Sync now, Paired devices (when each one last synced, and Unpair) and the name of this device are in Sync your devices. A device left with the default name Kodi asks for a name the first time, such as SHIELD or Tablet.
-luc_kodi only opens its network port (47788) while a PIN is on screen or while devices are paired, and only answers devices on your local network.
-Premiere Lists from 2.0.0 and 2.0.01 are kept as they are and get ready for syncing on their own.
